title: MolP2SBench: Do LLMs Really Reason from Molecular Properties to Structure?
abstract: arXiv:2610.12522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in molecular discovery and structure elucidation, where decisions depend on physical observations. Existing evaluations primarily focus on end-to-end molecular reconstruction, where correct predictions do not necessarily indicate reliance on the supplied properties. We introduce MolP2SBench, a benchmark for molecular property-to-structure (P2S) reasoning in LLMs. Each task presents a masked molecular scaffold with given properties and asks the model to select the missing structure from plausible candidates. We shuffle or replace properties to test reliance on correct property-structure pairing and responsiveness to counterfactual property changes. A channel-wise leaderboard uses Property-Grounded Recovery (PGR), giving equal weight to source and counterfactual recovery. translated_title: MolP2SBench：大语言模型真的能从分子性质推理出分子结构吗？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在分子发现和结构解析中的应用日益增多，而这些应用中的决策依赖于物理观测结果。现有评估主要集中于端到端的分子重建，在这种设置下，正确的预测并不一定意味着模型真正依赖于所提供的性质信息。我们提出了MolP2SBench，一个用于评估大语言模型“性质到结构”（P2S）推理能力的基准。每个任务给出一个带有遮蔽部分的分子骨架及其性质信息，要求模型从合理的候选结构中选出缺失的结构。我们通过打乱或替换性质信息，来测试模型对正确“性质-结构”配对的依赖程度以及对反事实性质变化的响应能力。我们采用基于通道的排行榜，使用“性质锚定恢复率”（PGR）指标，对原始恢复和反事实恢复给予同等权重。通过对七个模型的评估，我们发现大语言模型能够利用物理性质进行结构预测，但性能表现各异……
tldr: 提出MolP2SBench基准，通过遮蔽分子骨架、性质打乱与反事实测试系统评估大语言模型从分子性质到结构的推理能力，发现模型虽能利用物理性质预测结构，但未必真正依赖正确的性质-结构配对。
en_tdlr: We introduce MolP2SBench, a benchmark using masked molecular scaffolds, property shuffling, and counterfactual tests to evaluate whether LLMs truly reason from molecular properties to structures, finding that while LLMs can leverage physical properties for structure prediction, their reliance on correct property-structure pairings varies across models.
